# District scope. The engine checks the full target construction contract,
# including district level requirements, without checking owner affordability.

aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { scope:aub_payer = { has_character_flag = aub_funding_treasury_only } }
		scope:aub_payer = {
			has_treasury = yes
			treasury >= $GOLD$
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:aub_payer = { has_character_flag = aub_funding_personal_only } }
		scope:aub_payer = { gold >= $GOLD$ }
	}
	trigger_else = {
		scope:aub_payer = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_treasury = yes
					treasury >= $GOLD$
				}
				gold >= $GOLD$
			}
		}
	}
}
